name: Fuath Gremlin
text: You have a face like a seahorse, and your hands are surprisingly flexible lobster claws. You have the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air. In addition, you gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your claws are in the brawling group and have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
